results.title: Back up an instance on a dialect that is neither
results.evidence: the tool branches on `not dialect.startswith('sqlite')` and every non-SQLite dialect is told about `pg_dump` and `pg_basebackup`. An operator on MySQL, Oracle or a typo in the URL is handed PostgreSQL instructions — the remediation is confident and wrong, which reads as though somebody checked the dialect and did not. The refusal is right; only its addressee is assumed
